# Third-party licences

Licence blocks normalize CRLF line endings to LF. SHA-256 values identify the original source bytes before that formatting normalization.

Inventory for the locked Linux x86_64 GNU dependency graph. Derived using `cargo metadata --locked --offline --format-version 1` and `cargo tree --locked --offline --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --edges normal,build` plus `normal,no-proc-macro`. Runtime candidates are the normal graph excluding proc-macro edges; build-only means absent from that graph. This is dependency reachability, not a binary symbol/link audit. Dev-only and other-target crates are excluded. Regenerate for a changed lockfile, features or target.

The retained donor snapshot is covered separately by LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE. Rust toolchain and system dynamic-library distribution notices must be checked against the final package in REL-6.
